import numpy as np

def fairness_metrics(predictions, labels, protected):
    groups = np.unique(protected)
    g0, g1 = groups[0], groups[1]
    # Demographic parity
    dp = abs(np.mean(predictions[protected == g0]) - np.mean(predictions[protected == g1]))
    # Equal opportunity
    tpr_0 = np.mean(predictions[(protected == g0) & (labels == 1)])
    tpr_1 = np.mean(predictions[(protected == g1) & (labels == 1)])
    eo = abs(tpr_0 - tpr_1)
    # Equalized odds
    fpr_0 = np.mean(predictions[(protected == g0) & (labels == 0)])
    fpr_1 = np.mean(predictions[(protected == g1) & (labels == 0)])
    eodds = max(eo, abs(fpr_0 - fpr_1))
    return {'demographic_parity': dp, 'equal_opportunity': eo, 'equalized_odds': eodds}
